detail: The source braises in 750ml Pinot Noir, the ingredient the dish is named for; our card replaces it with beef broth only, with no acid (vinegar/grape juice) substituted - likely the deliberate site-wide no-alcohol adaptation, but nothing replaces the wine's role.

Our title promises 'Chicken and Saffron Rice' and the source steeps 5 saffron threads into the rice liquid, but our list and steps have no saffron and no turmeric substitute (our own arroz con pollo card shows turmeric is the available budget stand-in).
Source (beyondkimchee.com) grinds 15 cardamom pods into the signature Cape Malay spice blend; cardamom appears nowhere in our list or steps.
Source blend includes 2 tsp ground fennel; absent from our card, whose list instead carries 2.5 tbsp Italian Seasoning that appears nowhere in the source recipe.
Our title promises 'with Mashed Potatoes' but no potatoes are bought or cooked anywhere - the steps serve the meatloaf over rice, and the thecozycook source only suggests mashed potatoes as a side.
The source (thematbakh) mixes 1 cup finely chopped parsley into the kafta meat as a structural component; our list and steps have no parsley or any herb in the meat mixture.

The recipetineats source is built on Thai GREEN curry paste (Maesri), but our list buys Thai Kitchen RED curry paste (10 oz) for a dish titled 'Thai Green Curry Chicken', changing the title-defining flavor.
The source (paintthekitchenred) toasts 1/2 cup coconut slices in 1/4 cup coconut oil and cites 'fresh coconut' as a signature of the dish; our version has no coconut in any form.
The source uses 22 curry leaves across the pressure-cook and saute stages and names them a defining aromatic of Kerala beef fry; they appear nowhere in our list or steps.

The platingsandpairings sauce is 1/4 cup fish sauce + 1/4 cup SWEET soy + rice vinegar; ours subs plain soy and buys no sugar at all, dropping the sauce's defining sweetness even though the catalog stocks ABC Kecap Manis (used in turkey-nasi-goreng).

The source (rasamalaysia) finishes with 5 tbsp kerisik, the ingredient that defines rendang against an ordinary coconut curry; our version has no toasted coconut in any form and no substitute beyond the canned coconut milk.
Our title names vodka and the source deglazes with 1/2 cup vodka to build the sauce, but our card neither buys nor mentions any vodka or substitute deglazing liquid.

Our own title is 'Lemongrass Pork Noodle Bowls (Bun Thit Nuong)' and the RecipeTin Eats source uses lemongrass-marinated pork, but no lemongrass in any form appears in our list or steps; our marinade is only fish sauce and sugar.
The source's nuoc cham contains 5 cloves of finely chopped garlic (and the marinade more), but garlic appears nowhere in our list or steps.

Source (chilipeppermadness.com) finishes the chicken in a mole poblano sauce built on dried chiles (ancho/guajillo/pasilla/mulato) and chocolate; our card sells 'Chicken Mole' but its sauce is only fresh poblano + peanut + chili powder, with no dried chiles or chocolate anywhere.

Our title promises 'Cilantro Lime Rice' and the source's rice uses lime zest/juice and 1 cup cilantro, but our list and steps contain no cilantro or lime; our rice step substitutes 'a squeeze of the pineapple juice'.

The source's pares braising sauce (Kawaling Pinoy) simmers 2 star anise with the soy and brown sugar, the aromatic that distinguishes pares from plain braised beef; it appears nowhere in our list or steps.

https://www.budgetbytes.com/cheeseburger-rice/ returns HTTP 404, and a site-restricted search finds no 'Cheeseburger Rice' recipe on budgetbytes.com (nearest match is 'One Pot Cheeseburger Pasta' at /skillet-cheeseburger-pasta/).

Source (recipetineats) puts 1 tsp Sichuan pepper powder in the dan dan sauce and the dish is titled 'Sichuan'; our card has no Sichuan peppercorn anywhere and Lao Gan Ma chili crisp does not supply the numbing element.

Source URL https://www.mexicoinmykitchen.com/chipotle-sauce-meatballs-albondigas/ returns HTTP 403 (bot-wall) on repeated fetches; internal list-vs-steps check was clean, source comparison not performed.
Source URL https://www.marionskitchen.com/cambodian-pepper-beef-lok-lak/ returns HTTP 403 (bot-wall) on repeated fetches; internal list-vs-steps check was clean, source comparison not performed.

https://www.196flavors.com/ghana-shoko/ returned HTTP 500 Internal Server Error on three separate attempts, so the source comparison could not be made; the internal steps-vs-list check found no unused purchases or step contradictions.

The dish is named for it in our own title, and the source calls the 440 ml of Guinness the sauce's defining flavor, but our list never buys it and our step only says 'add a can of stout here if you are using it'.

WebFetch is blocked from www.thespruceeats.com ('Claude Code is unable to fetch from www.thespruceeats.com'), so the source at /chiles-rellenos-casserole-3057402 could not be read; our card's internal list-vs-steps check found no defect.
